page: Google Cloud Platform a4x-highgpu-4g is an accelerator-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the a4x server family. It features 140 dedicated vCPUs based on the arm64 CPU architecture, paired with 884.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 6.31 GB of RAM per core. The primary compute acceleration is delivered by four integrated NVIDIA GB200 GPUs.

This instance configuration does not include any local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. Additionally, the instance does not bundle any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The arm64 CPU architecture requires software and workloads to be compiled specifically for ARM, which represents a compatibility tradeoff compared to x86-64 environments.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of specialized GPU hardware and dedicated arm64 vCPUs positions this instance for high-throughput parallel processing tasks. It is designed for workloads such as large language model inference, deep learning training, data science pipelines, and highly parallelized scientific simulations that can leverage the NVIDIA GB200 accelerators.
